steps.title: First-run window
steps.expected: The Set up ModelPlan window lists the tools found in the seeded profile (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, ZCode, Kiro markers), one row each with a checkbox (checklist 3); Open at login is on by default; the widget is visible beside it.

steps.title: First run: Open at login unticked
steps.expected: Open at login is unticked in this synthetic HOME only (the box has one state per run; the tool ticks it off before Done so no login item stays behind). The tool rows keep their checkboxes.

steps.title: First run finished
steps.expected: Done closes the window and the widget stays. With the tool chooser (build 14) Done needs one tool ticked; a tool found is ticked by default, so the walk ticks one only when the page asks for it. Open at login was unticked in the step before. No hint is due here: v1 hints are for a concealed widget.

steps.title: Widget found and kept out
steps.expected: A fresh install starts with the widget collapsed (D56, build 14). The walk turns Auto-Collapse off in Settings > Quota Widget (the widget's own menu cannot be reached while it is collapsed) and uses Find Quota Widget to bring it out, so the rest, card and size steps see the whole widget. A build without Find Quota Widget starts expanded and skips this.

steps.title: Unreadable subscription has no ring
steps.expected: Gemini is detected (tool marker) but its login cannot be used, so it cannot be read. Its row on the widget carries no reading ('--') and no percentage; it is listed on the first-run page. Rings for Codex and the declared plans keep their readings (G3-38). NOTE: the build still draws a placeholder ring for Gemini; the step asserts only that it shows no reading.

steps.title: Widget at rest
steps.expected: Rings, gauges and percentages at rest. Pointer away from the widget.

steps.title: Widget hover and magnify
steps.expected: The ring under the pointer magnifies; the others stay put.

steps.title: Card per ring
steps.expected: Pointing at each painted ring opens that ring's own card. The manifest also records what opens at the frame the app reports.

steps.title: Drag, carried
steps.expected: While carried the widget follows the pointer; no click-through outline shows.

steps.title: Drag and snap
steps.expected: Released near the left edge, the widget snaps to that edge. No card is open.

steps.title: Quota Widget size S
steps.expected: Settings > Quota Widget size S resizes the widget; the visual comparison reads its window shot against the prototype's S widget. Taken right after the drag-snap, while all five synthetic rings are still there and the widget is docked on the left edge like the prototype.

steps.title: Quota Widget size L
steps.expected: Settings > Quota Widget size L resizes the widget; the visual comparison reads its window shot against the prototype's L widget.

steps.title: Quota Widget size back to M
steps.expected: Settings > Quota Widget size M restores the default widget.

steps.title: Status menu, right click
steps.expected: Right click shows the status menu with Show Quota Widget, Open Cockpit, Help, Settings and Quit.

steps.title: First-use hint
steps.expected: Turning the widget off from the status menu shows the hint at the menu bar icon telling how to get it back.

steps.title: Widget shown again
steps.expected: Show Quota Widget brings the widget back at its snapped place. The changed-pixel share against drag-snap is recorded, not asserted (animated critical rings change it).

steps.title: Help map from the status menu
steps.expected: Help in the status menu draws the help map over the visible widget; every note is on screen and readable to its end.

steps.title: Help map dismissed
steps.expected: Escape closes the help map.

steps.title: Widget collapsed to the sliver
steps.expected: Auto-Collapse from the widget's right-click menu folds the widget into the edge sliver once the pointer leaves. A ring at 0% must be obvious on the sliver (the prototype glows red). The sliver's own window is captured (.window.png, alpha kept) for the G3-58 comparison with the prototype's red.

steps.title: Widget revealed from the sliver
steps.expected: Pointing at the sliver brings the whole widget back at its snapped place.

steps.title: Auto-Collapse off
steps.expected: Turning Auto-Collapse off keeps the widget out after the pointer leaves.

steps.title: Widget out again after the collapse steps
steps.expected: Recovery, not a feature check: when the collapse steps leave the widget folded (build 14: the widget menu can close before Auto-Collapse is pressed), Auto-Collapse is turned off in Settings and Find Quota Widget brings it out, so the card, cockpit and size steps still see the whole widget.

steps.title: Popup card
steps.expected: A click on the top ring opens its card with the synthetic windows and reset times.

steps.title: Card of the third ring
steps.expected: With a card open, a click on the third ring shows the third ring's own card (G3-14).

steps.title: Quota card with a reserve line
steps.expected: The Codex ring's card has the vendor mark and name on one line and a Reserve line with the balance (420 credits); hovering the line explains in one sentence what the number means (checklist 13).

steps.title: Card closes when the pointer leaves
steps.expected: An unpinned card closes once the pointer has left the widget and the card (G3-14).

steps.title: Card of a ring at 0%
steps.expected: The card of a subscription with no quota left says so plainly; compare with the prototype's exhausted state.

steps.title: Card at 0% closed
steps.expected: Pointer away closes the card again.

steps.title: Cockpit open from a left click
steps.expected: Left click on the status item opens the cockpit (owner test build).

steps.title: Widget stays with the cockpit open
steps.expected: With the cockpit open the widget is still there; the cockpit may cover it (D49, G3-41).

steps.title: Bells before a session runs
steps.expected: No session is running: every bell under the engine columns is idle.

steps.title: Bells with a working glow
steps.expected: A Codex session of the seeded profile is running (its rollout gets a tool call every few seconds): the Codex bell reads 'working now' and glows under its engine column; the record strip lists the running session (checklist 8).

steps.title: Vendor marks on the tabs
steps.expected: The OpenAI (Codex) and Gemini CLI tab marks measure about the same by glyph bounds; the pictures of both tabs are kept (checklist 15).

steps.title: Menu bar percentage under the pointer
steps.expected: With the pointer resting on the menu bar icon for several seconds, its percentage stays '0%' (the lowest ring) and its tooltip text does not change (checklist 13/14).

steps.title: Porthole shutter closed
steps.expected: The shutter folds the porthole closed; the rest of the cockpit stays.

steps.title: Porthole shutter open and HUD
steps.expected: The shutter is open and the porthole shows the fleet with the HUD model list.

steps.title: Faders
steps.expected: One fader per model; moving one by a detent changes its effort step.

steps.title: Porthole enlarged 3D view
steps.expected: A click on the porthole opens the enlarged launch field in its own panel, rendering the 3D scene.

steps.title: Enlarged view closed
steps.expected: A second click on the porthole closes the enlarged panel.

steps.title: HUD row
steps.expected: A click on the first HUD row opens that model on the Effort page and nothing else. HUD rows are not in the accessibility tree, so the pointer goes by position. Build 14b changed the HUD layout, so the position click no longer lands on a row that opens the Effort page; the Effort check was dropped and the step keeps the no-new-window check (the HUD rows are not in the accessibility tree).

steps.title: Second subscription tab
steps.expected: Pressing the second tab lights it and scopes the table, faders and records to that subscription.

steps.title: All tab again
steps.expected: The All key returns every subscription.

steps.title: MFD page Subscription
steps.expected: The Subscription page key lights and the page shows its own content.

steps.title: MFD page Effort
steps.expected: The Effort page key lights and the page shows its own content.

steps.title: MFD page Breakdown
steps.expected: The Breakdown page key lights and the page shows its own content.

steps.title: Overview option key Bars | Grid
steps.expected: Back on Overview, the Bars | Grid key switches the chart to the heatmap.

steps.title: Press a fader name strip
steps.expected: Pressing a fader name strip opens that model's comparison on the MFD (Compare · model, Current, Try, Rec).

steps.title: Return from the comparison
steps.expected: The back key (or Back to Overview) ends the comparison and Overview lights again.

steps.title: ALERT lamp
steps.expected: Pressing the ALERT lamp opens the alert list on the MFD with a way back.

steps.title: Esc ends the comparison first
steps.expected: With a comparison open, Esc leaves the comparison and the cockpit stays open (CKP-SHELL-26).

steps.title: Fader drag opens Compare
steps.expected: Pulling a fader up opens the comparison page ('Compare · model', Current / Try / Rec, header 'Subscription'), the current page key dims (checklist 9).

steps.title: Back leaves the comparison
steps.expected: The Back key ends the comparison and Overview lights again (checklist 9).

steps.title: Esc leaves the comparison
steps.expected: A second fader drag opens the comparison again; Esc leaves it and the cockpit stays open (checklist 9).

steps.title: Menu bar icon closes the cockpit
steps.expected: A second left click on the menu bar icon closes the cockpit; the widget is there (G3-40).

steps.title: Cockpit opens again
steps.expected: Opened again (closed by the icon or, if that fails, by Close), the second open is quicker than the first; compare secondsTo with cockpit-open (G3-42).

steps.title: Cockpit under the icon, widget at its place
steps.expected: Before anything is moved the cockpit hangs under the menu bar icon, and the widget sits at its default place along the left edge; both frames are recorded for the reset check.

steps.title: Widget dragged along its edge, cockpit already off
steps.expected: The widget is dragged along its edge; it is not at its default place now. A drag away from the cockpit closes it (click outside).

steps.title: Cockpit opened again under the icon
steps.expected: The cockpit is opened again from the menu bar icon (it opens under the icon) before it is dragged off.

steps.title: Detached cockpit dragged by its title strip
steps.expected: Dragging the left part of the title strip moves the detached window (G3-43).

steps.title: Reset Position from the status menu
steps.expected: The status item menu has Reset Position (reached through the Accessibility API, no pointer on the item); choosing it brings the cockpit back under the menu bar icon and the widget back to its default place along its edge (away from where it was dragged) (checklist 6).

steps.title: Cockpit closed, widget back
steps.expected: Close shuts the cockpit; the widget is at its snapped place.

steps.title: Cockpit at 1440x900, Dock at the bottom
steps.expected: On a 1440x900 screen (13-inch MacBook Air) the full cockpit opens under the menu bar icon and fits between the menu bar and the Dock (G3-39). Hosted Macs offer no 1440x900, so the walk uses 1600x900: the same height, which is what decides the fit.

steps.title: Cockpit at 1470x956, Dock at the bottom
steps.expected: On a 1470x956 screen (MacBook Air M2/M3 default) the full cockpit fits between the menu bar and the Dock (G3-39). Hosted Macs offer no 1470x956, so the walk uses 1280x960: nearly the same height, which is what decides the fit.

steps.title: Cockpit closed, display restored
steps.expected: The cockpit closes from the menu bar icon and the display returns to the walk's size; the widget is on screen.

steps.title: Settings window
steps.expected: Settings… in the status menu opens the Settings window on its first page; the visual comparison reads its window shot.
